## Summary

Two new contracts, both **read-only / dry-run by construction** — nothing in this change can
write to the claim spine, flip a right or gate, or fetch a byte:

- **`evidence-audit/1`** — `db/src/db/evidence_audit.py` loads the `evidence-audit-rows/1`
  population (chunked claim → claim_evidence → evidence_capture → evidence_artifact →
  ingest_run join + `ingest_run_capture` marks + `spine_watermark` + claim eligibility via the
  shared `claim_eligible_sql` fragment) under `default_transaction_read_only=on`.
  `ops/src/ops/evidence_audit.py` builds a reproducible stratified frame — source family ×
  pre/post-roll capture epoch (2026-09-25 gcsfuse boundary) × predicate role × licence
  compartment — with `sha256(seed|claim_id)` deterministic sampling and census denominators
  that must reconcile to the selected population.

  Byte verification resolves the **pinned** OCFL version (never head) and recomputes the
  connector multihash — exact replayability is never derived from `source_id`. Five grades
  (`exact_replayable` / `document_locatable` / `source_attributed_only` / `unrecoverable` /
  `restricted_not_public`) plus findings for digest mismatch, missing object, unsupported
  role mapping, ambiguous lineage and dangling capture linkage. Restricted reads that cannot
  verify stay `UNVERIFIED` — never `missing`. The semantic trio is reported separately:
  support over **all** sampled eligible claims (unresolved counted not established),
  conditional adjudicated fidelity, and adjudication yield — evidence-unavailable units stay
  in the fidelity denominator, so missing evidence cannot inflate it by disappearing.

- **`recovery-plan/1`** — `ops/src/ops/recovery_plan.py` emits bounded, append-only action
  proposals (claim repair rows, bind-verified `claim_evidence`, `publication_disposition`
  withholds, disclosure notes) with row/disk/time estimates citing the measured
  ADR-107/111/114 ceilings. Ambiguous, unrecoverable, restricted and digest-mismatched units
  get **zero writes**; unrecoverable stays unrecoverable — a new fetch is never the old
  capture. Deterministic action digests are the resume marker: feeding prior digests via
  `--applied` yields `already_applied` and a `+0` re-plan (verified). The **live return-pass
  packet** pins the audit input digest, code commit, `publication-eligibility/1` policy
  version, runtime sqitch state, mounted OCFL root, commands and checklist — explicitly
  prepared-but-unexecuted, production mutation reserved for P32.22.

- **CLI** — additive verbs `sig-ops evidence-audit` (read-only `--dsn` or `--input-json`,
  `--capture-dir` OCFL root, recorded `--seed`/`--sample`/`--roll-boundary`) and
  `sig-ops recovery-plan` (`--audit`, `--applied`, `--repairs`, `--out`).

## Tests

- `tests/ops/test_evidence_audit.py` + `tests/ops/test_recovery_plan.py` — 51 tests covering
  the 28-row matrix: census reconciliation, seed determinism, every grade/finding class,
  lineage-vs-availability independence, semantic-trio denominator discipline,
  missing-cannot-inflate, zero-write rules, +0 restart, batch bounds, packet pins.
- `tests/db/test_evidence_audit_load.py` — 3 Docker/PG18 tests over the real sqitch deploy
  (loader row shape, watermark, read-only guarantee).

## Dry-run evidence

`docs/build/reports/p32.6-legacy-evidence/` — the committed fixture packet: 16-claim
`fixture_spine.json` covering every required byte class (recoverable / digest-mismatched /
missing / restricted / sealed / synthetic-only / unsupported-role), a real OCFL
`capture_root/`, `audit_report.json` + `AUDIT_REPORT.md` (16 claims, 12 strata, 16 sampled;
support_all = conditional fidelity = yield = 8/14 ≈ 57.1%; `reconciles` true), the
`recovery_plan.json` (18 actions, 2 proposed withholds, +0 on restart), `plan_digests.txt`,
and the prepared-unexecuted `live_return_pass_packet.json` + `LIVE_RETURN_PASS.md`. JSON
artifacts are byte-identical on regeneration.
